subject: website
name: ZLASER
summary: An artist site in a single plain HTML file with readable inline script, so the page is its own public source (no licence file). It runs no third-party code. It is not Level 4: when it opens it loads Google Fonts and an image from ImageKit, and it reads its works and exhibition log from JSONBin (api.jsonbin.io), a server it relies on.

connections.name: Google Fonts
connections.note: Fetched when the page opens; tells Google the visit.

connections.name: JSONBin API (api.jsonbin.io)
connections.note: The works and log data are read from it when the page opens.
